regulationReference: EU Regulation 576/2013 + Maltese veterinary authority requirements
notes: Malta requires tapeworm (Echinococcus) treatment in addition to all standard EU requirements.

additionalTasks.title: Tapeworm treatment (Echinococcus)
additionalTasks.description: Have a vet administer an approved tapeworm treatment (praziquantel or equivalent) between 1 and 5 days before arrival in Malta. Must be recorded on the EU health certificate.
additionalTasks.why: Malta has strict Echinococcus controls. This treatment is mandatory and must be noted by the vet on your health certificate.
documents: Treatment recorded on EU Health Certificate by the issuing vet
additionalTasks.notes: Praziquantel is the standard approved agent. Coordinate with your vet to have it recorded within the 10-day health cert window.
